title: Michael Shermer on the White House UAP science advisory committee

tellings.quote: part of the UF UAP science advisory committee that someone like an avi with connections to people in the government

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, speaking with Michael Shermer, a researcher well known as a skeptic, mentions a White House science advisory committee on UAP, which stands for unidentified anomalous phenomena, the government's newer word for UFOs. Michels speaks of it in 2026, loosely tying it to people with connections inside government, though he gives few details. If such a committee exists, it would mean the subject has reached the highest level of the US government.
